fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier, gate, or booth visible at any street curb cut: the west truck drive off 71st St is open (SV 2025-04, trucks rolling straight in to the SW dock pocket), the east drive serves the office/employee lots. Interior control deeper in the yard cannot be ruled out - flagged.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South-face canopy bank (~8-12 doors), NE dock court on the north building (~6-10), plus a SW dock pocket off the west drive (~6); ~24 total, at the 10-25/25-50 boundary.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Few drop trailers visible (~12 incl. pneumatic bulk trailers at the rail transfer); the large internal concrete yard is mostly empty maneuvering/staging space, not a trailer storage lot - hence dropYard false.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur curves off the IHB/BRC mainline into the NE yard (covered-hopper string on the main, bulk-transfer trailers at the spur). 71st St passes under the rail just east of the plant.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: South canopy bank vs NE dock court are physically separate clusters; inferred from overhead.
fieldNotes.westDrive: The west drive is shared with the neighboring distribution building (excluded from the perimeter); the boundary is drawn at the drive edge.
fieldNotes.northBoundary: Quaker parcel ends at the fence/green strip ~41.7646; the big white DC north of it is a separate facility.
